reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it directs viewers to promotions advertising an 8.6% APY, a digital-currency bonus, and a separate stock reward conditioned on a deposit while teaching ADA staking and delegation. The description says outcomes are not guaranteed, and the wallet demonstration does not show phrase entry or asset transfer, but the return-and-reward solicitation is part of the video's own linked promotional presentation.

citations.quote: we'll explain what staking Cardano is, how it works, and the step by step you need to do to join a Pool.
check our gifts and bonuses in the description to invest in cryptocurrencies with the best Market conditions
If you decide to stake your ADA for a set period of time, you'll periodically earn a return on your investment.
select delegate if you're sure that you want to delegate ADA to that pool.
Get 2 FREE stocks valued up to $1850 (when you deposit $100): https://bit.ly/3il4GQu

opening.argument: Judge the return language alongside the qualifications viewers actually receive. The creator says, "We don't guarantee a particular outcome," urges viewers to make their own decisions, and warns that a pool operator can take most or all rewards by changing its margin. Those are material limits on the idea that staking produces a certain payoff. The description also calls trading very risky. The bonuses deserve scrutiny, but their presence does not erase the video's explicit uncertainty and risk disclosures.

citations.quote: We don't guarantee a particular outcome as we have no inside knowledge. Do it with your own research and make your own decisions.
they can take most or all of the rewards from the pool by suddenly changing the margin to 99% or 100%, if they have malicious purposes.
Trading Bitcoin is VERY risky, and 90% of traders don't make money.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The cited statement about a periodic return says nothing about a guaranteed rate. The cited instruction to delegate is conditional on the viewer being sure. And the description's stock offer expressly says the reward is valued "up to" an amount and requires a deposit; those words do not establish that every viewer receives that value. Read with the stated non-guarantee, these quotes establish promotional and instructional content, but not a promise of a particular outcome.

citations.quote: If you decide to stake your ADA for a set period of time, you'll periodically earn a return on your investment.
select delegate if you're sure that you want to delegate ADA to that pool.
Get 2 FREE stocks valued up to $1850 (when you deposit $100): https://bit.ly/3il4GQu

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A non-guarantee does not remove the solicitation. The speaker directs viewers to bonuses in the description to invest, while that description advertises an 8.6% APY offer with a digital-currency bonus. The pool-margin warning qualifies staking rewards, but it does not address what the linked offer promises or how its terms work. The defense's risk quotes therefore do not account for the return-and-bonus promotion presented with the tutorial.

citations.quote: check our gifts and bonuses in the description to invest in cryptocurrencies with the best Market conditions
EARN PASSIVELY: Earn 8.6% APY + $250 Bonus in Digital Currency https://bit.ly/3iv4Kxj

opening.argument: The central activity is explaining how staking works and walking through a wallet's delegation controls. The narration distinguishes staking from lending, directs viewers to the official wallet website, and warns them not to share a recovery phrase. It then describes searching for a pool and choosing whether to delegate. Those concrete operational and security steps support reading the video as a tutorial, even though the description also carries offers.

citations.quote: It's important to mention that staking is completely different to lending crypto.
Ensure that you are downloading the Daedalus app from the official website.
Also don't share this recovery phrase with anyone.
In the search bar, type in the pool name that you want to delegate Ada to.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening's delegation quote fits an operational walkthrough: it tells viewers to select a pool only if they are sure. Its periodic-return quote describes the reason staking interests viewers, but does not by itself show a guaranteed payout or a required destination. The linked stock offer is a distinct description promotion, not a step in the cited wallet-delegation instruction.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Operational detail and security advice can coexist with a financial solicitation. The speaker explicitly tells viewers to check description bonuses to invest, and the description advertises an APY and bonus through a link. The defense's wallet instructions show how the tutorial is delivered; they do not explain away the return-focused promotion attached to it.

citations.quote: check our gifts and bonuses in the description to invest in cryptocurrencies with the best Market conditions
EARN PASSIVELY: Earn 8.6% APY + $250 Bonus in Digital Currency https://bit.ly/3iv4Kxj

opening.argument: The description groups the contested offers with recognizable forms of promotion: lower fees, a shared signup reward, and free stocks conditioned on a deposit. The record does not establish the linked services' terms or safety, but neither does the quoted offer text establish that the creator collects the deposit. In the wallet guidance, viewers are told to use the official website and never share their recovery phrase. On this evidence, referral-style promotion is a plausible reading; the missing details should not be filled in with an invented credential request or creator-controlled transfer.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The reference side correctly identifies a deposit-conditioned stock offer, but its quoted text does not say the deposit goes to the creator or show what happens after the link is opened. The staking-return quote likewise does not specify a guaranteed amount. The video also says staked ADA remains in the viewer's wallet. Those limits matter when deciding whether the cited material establishes more than a tutorial accompanied by promotions.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: No creator-controlled deposit or credential request needs to be inferred to assess what is shown. The video directs viewers to its description to invest, where a linked offer advertises 8.6% APY plus a bonus and another promises free stocks when viewers deposit $100. The defense cannot verify those destinations or terms from the record, and its wallet-safety quote does not qualify the separate linked offers.
